briefings.headline: Hunt Griffin’s fastball; stay disciplined on offspeed
briefings.message: Foster Griffin is the high-confidence predicted starter. Look for fastballs early: his fastball-heavy approach creates opportunities, especially for right-handed hitters. Vargas and Murakami stay in the lineup for favorable matchups; attack fastballs, and don’t chase offspeed down. Pereira can hunt breaking balls selectively, but that pitch-group sample is small. Be ready for their available left-handed relief options, PJ Poulin and Richard Lovelady, later in the game.
reminders: Fastballs early; make Griffin prove he can land breaking balls.
Avoid expanding on offspeed pitches, especially down.
Pereira’s breaking-ball edge comes from small samples.

Keep limited relievers as fallback options.
